findings.title: auth.users × zapp.profiles: UUID mismatch completo
findings.expected: 19 auth.users com profiles correspondentes (UUID = FK match)
findings.actual: 19 users_sem_profile E 19 profiles_sem_user — sobreposição UUID = ZERO
findings.impact: RLS completamente quebrado para todos os usuários — auth.uid() nunca encontra perfil
findings.evidence: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth.users u LEFT JOIN zapp.profiles p ON u.id=p.id WHERE p.id IS NULL → 19; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zapp.profiles p LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON p.id=u.id WHERE u.id IS NULL → 19
findings.action: 1) Verificar trigger on_auth_user_created; 2) UPDATE zapp.profiles SET id=auth.users.id WHERE email matches; 3) Confirmar RLS funcionando

findings.title: WAL slot cainophile_tqoilw2f com lag 281 MB crescente
findings.expected: Slot ativo com consumer consumindo — lag < 100 MB ou decrescente
findings.actual: Lag 281 MB (294.522.800 bytes) — crescendo durante sessão (271 MB → 281 MB). Status: reserved
findings.impact: Risco de disco cheio no servidor se slot não for consumido; crescimento ilimitado do WAL retido
findings.evidence: SELECT slot_name, wal_status, pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), confirmed_flush_lsn) FROM pg_replication_slots WHERE slot_name='cainophile_tqoilw2f'
findings.action: Verificar consumer do slot. Se inativo, executar: SELECT pg_drop_replication_slot('cainophile_tqoilw2f') após confirmação

findings.title: evolution-db-purge: OOM killed (137) e command not found (127)
findings.expected: Container executa limpeza de dados Evolution API sem erros
findings.actual: Múltiplas instâncias: Exited(137) = OOM killed, Exited(127) = command not found
findings.impact: Falha na limpeza de dados — possível crescimento de tabelas evo sem purge; erro de entrypoint indica problema de imagem
findings.evidence: portainer_list_containers → containers evolution-db-purge* com status Exited e exit codes 137/127
findings.action: 1) Aumentar limite de memória do container; 2) Verificar entrypoint/command na imagem; 3) Testar execução manual da purge
